profile.name: Sreejith S
profile.headline: Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
bio: I'm a Computer Science student at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, passionate about building software that solves real problems.
I enjoy working on full-stack, AI/ML and IoT-based solutions, and I'm always curious to learn new technologies and take on challenging projects that create real impact.
